sections.title: Upper bounds for the generalized volume conjecture
sections.extract: \lbl{sub.results} Our next theorem is an upper bound for the Generalized Volume Conjecture. Let $\Re(\a)$ denote the real part of $\a$. \begin{theorem} \lbl{thm.up} {\rm (Proof in Section \ref{sub.thmup})} For every knot $K$ with $c+2$ crossings and every $\a \in \BC$, we have $$ \limsup_{n \to \infty} \frac{\log|f_{K,n}(\a)|}{n} \leq c \log 4 + \frac{c+2}{2}|\Re(\a)|. $$ \end{theorem}
